development_baseline.name: v11 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 0.75 * v11 development residual (runs/adsb_v11/development_residuals.parquet, leave-one-month-out), floored; reproduces 333.914 / 277.689 / 200.421 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each scope the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.recipe: v11 = v9 + 0.75 * ADS-B surface residual on matched rows (configs/adsb_v11_v1.json, residual_matched_75)

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after v11 scored 248.4368 officially (4th of 142; third 247.0109). v11's leave-one-month-out development gave -2.90% / -3.62% / -8.85% versus v9 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025. The neighbour features (nb_*) were written and timed (81 s per month) but never scored against any label before this declaration; a post-v11 decomposition (no new model) showed unmatched rows at covered airports at 180-300 s RMSE versus 76-142 s for matched rows, and that 55-80% of the remaining squared error sits at LIRF, LFPG, LTFM and EGLL. Expected size of this step: 0.3-1% on the ranking.

residual_model.applies_to: the candidate's scope, for training and prediction alike; every row outside the scope keeps the v9 prediction exactly
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and scope come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected scope's three development round counts

scopes.context: departures with a matched segment OR at least one matched neighbour on the same runway within 30 minutes (adsb_matched == 1 or nb_runway_30m_count > 0)
scopes.matched: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment (adsb_matched == 1)

configuration.selection: For each candidate (scope, weight), RMSE of (v9 + weight * residual on the scope) on each held-out month versus the v11 development prediction on the same rows (all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is at least 0.2% lower than the v11 development RMSE on EACH of the three months. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v11; otherwise select nothing. Ratios to v9, per-airport tables and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v11 are descriptive only.
